name: ctrscm
description: Mechanically externalize old tool-result text during compaction while preserving conversation text and tool calls. Recover original output from paged local artifacts; fall back to built-in compaction when Shake cannot safely save enough context. The Shake idea comes from OMP (oh-my-pi, https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi) by Can Bölük, Mario Zechner and Stencil Labs, Inc.

protectTokens.title: Protected recent context
protectTokens.description: Estimated tokens of recent context protected from Shake.

minSavings.title: Minimum savings
minSavings.description: Minimum estimated token savings required to apply Shake.

minResultTokens.title: Minimum result size
minResultTokens.description: Minimum estimated tokens in an eligible tool result.

protectedTools.title: Protected tools
protectedTools.description: Comma-separated tool names whose results are never externalized.

fallback.title: Shake fallback
fallback.description: Use built-in compaction or skip when Shake is not applied.

autoShake.title: Automatic Shake
autoShake.description: Request proactive Shake as the context fills.

triggerPercent.title: Context trigger percent
triggerPercent.description: Context percentage at which proactive Shake is requested.

triggerTokens.title: Context trigger tokens
triggerTokens.description: Context token count at which proactive Shake is requested; zero disables this threshold.

adviseTokens.title: Advice threshold tokens
adviseTokens.description: Context token count at which CTRSCM recommends /compact or a new session; zero disables advice.

idleShakeMinutes.title: Idle Shake minutes
idleShakeMinutes.description: Minutes of idle time after which the next prompt first requests an idle Shake; zero disables it.

usageLog.title: Usage log
usageLog.description: Write one count-and-id usage event file under the artifact root for each tracked event.

cooldownTurns.title: Shake cooldown
cooldownTurns.description: Measurements to wait between proactive Shake requests.

aggressiveProtectTokens.title: Aggressive protected context
aggressiveProtectTokens.description: Estimated tokens protected by a queued or manual aggressive Shake.
